title: Ancillary Justice
author: Ann Leckie
summary: The last surviving fragment of a starship's mind now lives in a single human body. She sets out on a quiet, patient quest for revenge on the ruler of the empire that destroyed her.
readIf: you like cerebral space opera that plays with identity, language and the structure of an empire.
skipIf: you dislike two timelines and a lot of unfamiliar terms in the opening chapters.

pairings.reason: Another dense, culturally rich space empire seen by someone caught in its politics.
The classic that first made readers rethink gender and identity in science fiction.
A lighter, much shorter story of a constructed mind on a mission, with plenty of humour.
